slice: Cannon Racecraft: the maker's printed spring application chart (fork and shock spring part numbers and the rates offered, by bike and year)
notes: Read from the PDF chart supplied by the owner; the PDF is not kept. No rider-weight recommendations are printed. Rows for bikes outside the app, or whose model wording is not mapped, are in unread.
